Download one attachment URL into the planscanR cache.

Source: R/download_public.R
download_to_cache.Rd

Fetches a single URL into the planscanR cache, behaving exactly as planscanR's own downloader does. In order, it:

Usage

download_to_cache(
  url,
  country,
  document_id,
  cache_dir = cache_dir_default(),
  max_file_size_mb = getOption("planscanR.max_file_size_mb", 50),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  content_addressed = FALSE,
  storage_root_id = "cache",
  storage_guard = NULL
)

Arguments

url

Source URL (character scalar).

country

ISO-2 country code.

document_id

Portal-native document ID.

cache_dir

Cache root. Defaults to cache_dir_default().

max_file_size_mb

Per-file size ceiling in MiB. Defaults to getOption("planscanR.max_file_size_mb", 50). Inf, NULL, or a non-positive value means no cap.

overwrite

If FALSE (default) and a verified file is already cached, it is returned as-is with status "exists". If TRUE, the URL is re-fetched; a failed attempt leaves an existing verified copy in place.

content_addressed

Place a verified copy under objects/sha256/ab/cd/<sha256> and return its portable location. The legacy per-project copy and its URL-specific receipt are retained. Defaults to FALSE for backward compatibility.

storage_root_id

Stable root ID to include in the returned location; defaults to the built-in cache root.

storage_guard

Optional callback used by an acquisition coordinator to authorize bytes before they are written. It receives cumulative bytes already written, the advertised size (or NA), and may accept phase and pending_bytes arguments. A guard error or FALSE result fails closed. When omitted, the historical max_file_size_mb behavior is unchanged.

Value

A one-row tibble with columns: url, local_path (NA when skipped/failed), size_bytes, sha256 (NA when no local file), status, reason. status is one of "downloaded", "exists", "skipped_size", or "failed".

Details

  • resolves the destination path with cache_path();

  • runs a cheap HEAD probe and skips the URL if its advertised Content-Length already exceeds the cap, so an over-size file is never transferred;

  • streams through the shared throttled, retrying httr2 client into a same-filesystem staging path, enforcing the size cap while receiving;

  • checks the GET length and rejects empty bodies or clear HTML/login/error pages before publication; MIME and magic bytes are identification hints, so arbitrary nonempty attachment bytes are retained;

  • finalizes the file extension (a URL with no extension lands at a .x placeholder, renamed from the URL, magic bytes, response Content-Type, or a stable .bin fallback);

  • computes the SHA-256, publishes its verification receipt, and atomically renames the completed file.

This is the public, single-URL counterpart to planscanR's internal batch downloader; it is intended for downstream callers (e.g. mirroring to external storage) that need one file in the canonical cache location with a structured result.

See also

cache_path(), resolve_cached_path()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_to_cache(
  "https://pas.commissiemer.nl/files/nl/3619/a3619ts.pdf",
  country = "nl",
  document_id = "3619"
)
} # }
